scientific_objective: Discriminate genuine earlier joint-distribution dependence on an independently later physical intervention from standard delayed-choice quantum heralding, forward randomness, leakage and postselection.

research_sources.title: Experimental delayed-choice entanglement swapping
research_sources.verified_statement: Four-photon actual late Victor QRNG choice after early Alice/Bob registrations, entanglement/separability distinguished after late measurement
research_sources.limit: The published conditional quantum correlations do not allow a message to be read in the past.

research_sources.title: Theories with no superluminal signaling have greater information-processing power than theories with no superluminal causation
research_sources.verified_statement: Theory-only possibility of operationally certifiable violations of no-superluminal-causation via hypothetical jamming-type resources
research_sources.limit: No experimentally implemented postquantum jamming apparatus is demonstrated by the paper.

exact_ideal_4_photon_model.early_photons: qubits 1, 4 measured in Z basis before Victor
exact_ideal_4_photon_model.late_photons: qubits 2, 3 measured after independent Victor choice of BSM or SSM
exact_ideal_4_photon_model.unconditional_early_P_XZ_given_B: Uniform for both future settings; each of 00,01,10,11 has probability 1/4
exact_ideal_4_photon_model.BSM_PHI_PLUS_heralded_conditional: P(00|PHI+)=1/2; P(11|PHI+)=1/2; P(01)=P(10)=0, but only after late outcome is known
exact_ideal_4_photon_model.hypothetical_nonphysical_jamming_parity: X XOR Z = later B; single earlier marginals unchanged; joint total-variation distance=1
exact_ideal_4_photon_model.naive_postselection_trap: Select only ordinary events with B=X XOR Z; discards 50% of initial attempts and creates the same selected joint table as hypothetical jamming.

fixed_N_synthetic_control.primary_measure: Total variation of all nine earlier joint X,Z categories including NO_CLICK, conditional on later B=0 versus B=1
synthetic_false_positive_guards: late field in early record forbidden
unfrozen alpha or permutation budget forbidden
clock order must hold within reported synthetic metadata

planted_future_bit_before_early_CPU_gene.actual_cause: B preloaded into early CPU simulation, intentionally breaks real chronology

fixed_N_synthetic_control.correlations_between_synthetic_scenarios: The null and heralded controls deliberately share the same seeded early records and late B assignments. They are NOT two independent replications and their identical primary p-values must not be double-counted.
fixed_N_synthetic_control.interpretation: Significant synthetic positive control demonstrates statistic sensitivity only. Standard quantum model makes no unconditional earlier dependence. Neither implies actual future-to-past signalling.

requirements: Four-photon preparation and separate earlier Alice/Bob photon event time tags
Independent physically later QRNG choice B and Victor BSM/SSM intervention
Complete trigger count and raw NO_CLICK/loss/abort data before B known
Independent hardware-time attestation with certified uncertainty and tamper-evident log
Fixed N=2048 and nine-category test locked before late choices, no postselection
Separate physically independent blind replication with external custody of all logs
Exclude forward causal leakage, common controllers, backdated time tags, predictable QRNG and later filtering before a physical interpretation
physical_hardware_preregistration.critical_time_seal_caveat: The 2012 Ma apparatus used nanosecond-scale ordering. Uploading SHA256 manifests to GitHub is far too slow and cannot itself seal earlier data before the late experimental choice; trusted independent hardware time-tagging or a much longer genuine quantum delay is required.

conclusion.next_scientific_hinge: Obtain an actual independent hardware time-tagged early-and-late photon dataset with full NO_CLICK events and certified late choice chronology, or controlled optical apparatus to collect it; then run the already locked 2048-shot unfiltered analysis.
